name: triptally-root
description: TripTally - Collaborative Trip Planning for Friends & Groups

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgGreen.bold,bgBlue.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
